id-20260817-intro-real-estate-14.title: [Property #14] Buying Property is Easy, Maintenance and Taxes Are What Surprise You

segments.src: > Properti tidak berhenti menghasilkan uang di hari akad — ia terus meminta biaya perawatan dan pajak, dan selisih antara "yield brosur" dan "yield dompet" biasanya lahir di situ.
segments.tr: > Property doesn't stop making money on closing day — it keeps asking for maintenance costs and taxes, and the gap between the "brochure yield" and the "wallet yield" is usually born right there.

segments.src: Banyak orang mengukur properti dari satu angka saja: harga beli dan harga jual.
segments.tr: Many people measure property by just one number: purchase price and selling price.

segments.src: Padahal di antara dua titik itu ada masa kepemilikan yang bisa berlangsung 10–20 tahun, dan di sepanjang masa itu properti terus mengeluarkan biaya.
segments.tr: Yet between those two points lies a holding period that can last 10–20 years, and throughout that time the property keeps incurring costs.

segments.src: Inilah dua hal yang kita bahas hari ini: **manajemen properti** (mengelola aset agar tetap menghasilkan) dan **perpajakan properti** (biaya yang wajib dibayar ke negara).
segments.tr: These are the two things we discuss today: **property management** (managing assets so they keep producing) and **property taxation** (costs that must be paid to the state).

segments.src: **Manajemen properti** intinya menjaga agar pendapatan tetap masuk dan biaya tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: **Property management** is essentially keeping income coming in and costs under control.

segments.src: Ukuran yang paling sering dipakai adalah *Net Operating Income* (NOI):
segments.tr: The most frequently used metric is *Net Operating Income* (NOI):

segments.src: NOI = Pendapatan sewa efektif - Biaya operasional
segments.tr: NOI = Pendapatan sewa efektif - Biaya operasional

segments.src: Kata kuncinya "efektif": kalau unit kosong dua bulan setahun, pendapatan Anda cuma 10 bulan.
segments.tr: The keyword is "effective": if the unit is vacant for two months a year, your income is only 10 months.

segments.src: Biaya operasional mencakup IPL/service charge, perawatan, asuransi, biaya agen, dan — ini yang sering dilupakan — pajak.
segments.tr: Operational costs include IPL/service charge, maintenance, insurance, agent fees, and — what is often forgotten — taxes.

segments.src: **Perpajakan properti** di Indonesia bisa dikelompokkan berdasarkan tiga momen:
segments.tr: **Property taxation** in Indonesia can be grouped into three moments:

segments.src: 1. **Saat memperoleh.** Pembeli membayar **BPHTB** (Bea Perolehan Hak atas Tanah dan Bangunan), tarif maksimal 5% dari nilai perolehan setelah dikurangi NPOPTKP (paling sedikit Rp80 juta; untuk warisan/hibah wasiat paling sedikit Rp300 juta). Kalau membeli unit baru dari pengembang, ada tambahan PPN, dan properti sangat mewah bisa kena PPnBM.
segments.tr: 1. **Upon acquisition.** The buyer pays **BPHTB** (Land and Building Rights Acquisition Duty), with a maximum rate of 5% of the acquisition value after deducting NPOPTKP (at least Rp80 million; for inheritance/testamentary grants at least Rp300 million). If buying a new unit from a developer, there is an additional VAT, and very luxury properties may be subject to PPnBM.

segments.src: 2. **Saat memiliki.** Setiap tahun terbit **SPPT PBB-P2**. Dasarnya bukan harga beli Anda, melainkan **NJOP** yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah. Tarif maksimalnya 0,5%, tetapi tarif riilnya ditentukan Perda masing-masing daerah dan umumnya jauh di bawah itu. Kalau unit disewakan, penghasilan sewa tanah/bangunan dikenai **PPh Final 10%** dari sewa bruto.
segments.tr: 2. **Upon ownership.** Every year the **SPPT PBB-P2** is issued. The basis is not your purchase price, but the **NJOP** determined by the regional government. The maximum rate is 0.5%, but the actual rate is determined by each region's Regional Regulation (Perda) and is generally well below that. If the unit is rented out, the land/building rental income is subject to a **Final Income Tax (PPh Final) of 10%** of the gross rent.

segments.src: 3. **Saat melepas.** Penjual dikenai **PPh Final atas pengalihan hak** sebesar 2,5% dari nilai pengalihan bruto (bukan dari keuntungan). Untuk rumah sederhana/rusun sederhana dari pengembang, tarifnya 1%.
segments.tr: 3. **Upon disposal.** The seller is subject to a **Final PPh on the transfer of rights** of 2.5% of the gross transfer value (not from profit). For simple houses/simple flats from developers, the rate is 1%.

segments.src: Poin penting yang membedakan properti dari deposito: pajak saat memiliki (PBB) dan pajak saat melepas (PPh final) dihitung dari **nilai**, bukan dari **untung**.
segments.tr: An important point that distinguishes property from deposits: the tax upon ownership (PBB) and tax upon disposal (Final PPh) are calculated from **value**, not from **profit**.

segments.src: Properti yang dijual rugi pun tetap kena 2,5%.
segments.tr: Even properties sold at a loss are still subject to the 2.5%.

segments.src: Bu Ratna membeli apartemen dua kamar di Bekasi seharga **Rp600 juta**, lalu menyewakannya **Rp3,5 juta per bulan** — Rp42 juta setahun.
segments.tr: Mrs. Ratna bought a two-bedroom apartment in Bekasi for **Rp600 million**, then rented it out for **Rp3.5 million per month** — Rp42 million a year.

segments.src: Di brosur agen, angkanya terlihat manis: 42 dibagi 600 = **yield 7%**.
segments.tr: On the agent's brochure, the number looks sweet: 42 divided by 600 = **7% yield**.

segments.src: Dan itu belum menghitung risiko unit kosong: satu bulan kosong saja memangkas NOI sekitar Rp3,5 juta, menurunkan yield ke sekitar 4,0%.
segments.tr: And that doesn't count vacancy risk: a single vacant month trims NOI by about Rp3.5 million, dropping the yield to around 4.0%.

segments.tr: Five years later Mrs. Ratna sold the unit for **Rp700 million**.

Meanwhile, the buyer prepares their own costs:

segments.src: Ditambah biaya notaris/PPAT, balik nama, dan komisi agen.
segments.tr: Plus notary/PPAT fees, name transfer, and agent commissions.

segments.src: Jadi selisih Rp100 juta yang terlihat sebagai "untung" menyusut cukup banyak sebelum sampai ke tangan.
segments.tr: So the Rp100 million difference that looks like "profit" shrinks quite a bit before reaching her hands.

segments.src: Ini alasan pelaku properti profesional selalu memisahkan dua angka: *gross yield* untuk memikat, *net yield* untuk mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: This is why professional property investors always separate two numbers: *gross yield* to entice, *net yield* to make decisions.

segments.src: 1. Manajemen properti mengubah "punya aset" menjadi "aset yang menghasilkan"; ukurannya NOI, yaitu sewa efektif dikurangi seluruh biaya operasional termasuk pajak.
segments.tr: 1. Property management turns "having an asset" into "an asset that produces"; the metric is NOI, which is effective rent minus all operational costs including taxes.

segments.src: 2. Pajak properti muncul di tiga momen — BPHTB saat membeli, PBB tahunan plus PPh Final 10% atas sewa saat memiliki, dan PPh Final 2,5% saat menjual.
segments.tr: 2. Property taxes appear at three moments — BPHTB when buying, annual PBB plus 10% Final PPh on rent when owning, and 2.5% Final PPh when selling.

segments.src: 3. PBB dihitung dari NJOP dan PPh pengalihan dihitung dari nilai transaksi, bukan dari keuntungan — sehingga properti yang merugi pun tetap menanggung pajak.
segments.tr: 3. PBB is calculated from NJOP and transfer PPh is calculated from transaction value, not from profit — so even losing properties still bear taxes.

segments.src: **1.** Dalam transaksi jual beli properti biasa, siapa yang secara aturan menanggung BPHTB?
segments.tr: **1.** In a standard property transaction, who by rule bears the BPHTB?

segments.src: a) Penjual b) Pembeli c) Notaris/PPAT d) Pemerintah daerah
segments.tr: a) Seller b) Buyer c) Notary/PPAT d) Regional government

segments.src: **2.** (B/S) PBB-P2 setiap tahun dihitung dari harga transaksi terakhir properti tersebut.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Annual PBB-P2 is calculated from the property's last transaction price.

segments.src: **3.** Berapa tarif PPh Final atas penghasilan sewa tanah dan/atau bangunan?
segments.tr: **3.** What is the Final PPh rate on land and/or building rental income?

segments.src: - **NJOP (Nilai Jual Objek Pajak):** nilai properti yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah sebagai dasar penghitungan PBB; biasanya berbeda dari harga pasar.
segments.tr: - **NJOP (Tax Object Selling Value):** property value determined by the regional government as the basis for calculating PBB; usually different from market price.

segments.src: - **PBB-P2:** pajak daerah yang dibayar tiap tahun oleh pemilik tanah/bangunan, dengan tarif maksimal 0,5% sesuai Perda setempat.
segments.tr: - **PBB-P2:** regional tax paid annually by land/building owners, with a maximum rate of 0.5% according to local Perda.

segments.src: - **BPHTB:** pungutan yang dibayar **pembeli** saat memperoleh hak atas tanah/bangunan, maksimal 5% setelah dikurangi NPOPTKP.
segments.tr: - **BPHTB:** levy paid by the **buyer** upon acquiring land/building rights, maximum 5% after deducting NPOPTKP.

segments.src: - **PPh Final Pengalihan Hak:** pajak 2,5% dari nilai pengalihan bruto yang ditanggung **penjual** (1% untuk rumah sederhana dari pengembang).
segments.tr: - **Final PPh on Transfer of Rights:** 2.5% tax on gross transfer value borne by the **seller** (1% for simple houses from developers).

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income):** pendapatan sewa efektif dikurangi biaya operasional — angka inti untuk menilai kinerja properti sewa.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income):** effective rental income minus operational costs — the core figure for evaluating rental property performance.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — BPHTB adalah kewajiban pihak yang memperoleh hak, yaitu pembeli; penjual menanggung PPh Final 2,5%.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — BPHTB is the obligation of the party acquiring rights, namely the buyer; the seller bears the 2.5% Final PPh.

segments.src: 2) Salah — dasarnya NJOP yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah, bukan harga transaksi Anda; karena itu SPPT dua tetangga dengan harga beli berbeda bisa mirip.
segments.tr: 2) False — the basis is the NJOP determined by the regional government, not your transaction price; hence SPPTs of two neighbors with different purchase prices can be similar.

segments.src: 3) c — 10% bersifat final dari sewa bruto; jika penyewa adalah badan usaha, pajak itu dipotong langsung oleh penyewa.*
segments.tr: 3) c — 10% is final from gross rent; if the tenant is a business entity, that tax is withheld directly by the tenant.*

segments.src: *Catatan: tarif PBB, NJOPTKP, NPOPTKP, serta insentif PPN properti bisa berbeda antardaerah dan berubah dari waktu ke waktu.
segments.tr: *Note: PBB rates, NJOPTKP, NPOPTKP, and property VAT incentives can differ between regions and change over time.

segments.src: Sebelum bertransaksi, cek SPPT terbaru, Perda setempat, dan konsultasikan dengan notaris/PPAT atau konsultan pajak.*
segments.tr: Before transacting, check the latest SPPT, local Perda, and consult with a notary/PPAT or tax consultant.*
